mlag.note: Two independent Nexus switches form a vPC domain for active/active multichassis link aggregation, over a peer link built from front-panel Ethernet ports. Each peer keeps its own control and management plane; this is not a stack

stacking.note: No hardware stacking. Nexus switches are deployed as independent systems; multichassis redundancy is vPC

routing.summary: NX-OS Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, IS-IS, EIGRP, RIPv2, BGP/MP-BGP, PIM-SM/SSM, MSDP, HSRP, VRRP, VXLAN BGP EVPN, Segment Routing. Layer 3 unicast and multicast routing require a license beyond the default Layer 2 feature set

licensing: Default system software covers Layer 2 security and management. Layer 3 unicast and multicast routing and Nexus Data Broker need additional licensing; sold as Data Center Networking (DCN) Essentials, Advantage or Premier subscriptions, or perpetual. SyncE is a separate add-on license (DCN-SYNCE-XF)
routeScale: 1,792,000 IPv4 LPM routes and IPv4 host entries; 896,000 IPv6 LPM routes and 1,792,000 IPv6 host entries
macsec: IEEE 802.1ae MACsec and CloudSec on all ports at 1G and above (feature license required)

power.summary: Up to two hot-swappable power supplies: 650W AC, 930W DC or 1200W HVAC/HVDC. Four hot-swappable fans, port-side intake or exhaust

note: NX-OS only; ACI mode is not supported. Flexible forwarding tables support up to two million shared entries. Can be converted to a Fabric Extender with a software FEX mode command

models.note: PTP telecom profile G.8275.1 with SyncE, boundary clock G.8273.2 Class B, plus GNSS antenna, 1PPS and 10MHz inputs and a ToD RJ-45
